verdict.rationale: Dropbox ships Dash, a first-party AI surface with documented capabilities to summarize files, answer questions about documents, review documents, and organize files with AI, plus plan pages advertising 'Edit PDFs and get signatures' and 'Integrate with leading AI tools.' These are documented product pages (not just an announcement), covering ask/summarize/extract use cases. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of Dash's AI quality/accuracy, and clearer detail on extraction capabilities beyond summarization/Q&A.
